title: Context Window Budget Calculator
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI for EE Research
description: Calculator activity in which learners compute the tokens left for a completion from a context window size and the sizes of the system prompt, history, attachment, and latest message, and decide whether a requested completion fits. Three illustrative challenges in a fixed order allow two attempts each and reveal the worked subtraction and a stacked bar of the window; an exploration mode then offers four sliders and shows the remaining space and whether a 6,000-token completion fits.

educational.topic: Context window budgeting for prompts and completions
learningObjectives: Calculate the number of tokens left for a completion from a context window size and the sizes of the prompt components, and state whether a requested completion fits
prerequisites: Token, context window, prompt, and completion
The estimate of tokens as words divided by 0.75

accessibility.notes: describe() provides a screen-reader description; all controls are native HTML elements (buttons, select lists, text input, range sliders) reachable with the Tab key; correct and incorrect feedback uses words and symbols as well as color; colors come from the Okabe-Ito color-blind-safe palette; body text is 15 px or larger.

controls.label: tokens remaining
controls.purpose: Text box for the learner's remaining-token answer; accepts whole numbers with optional commas and a minus sign.

controls.label: fits / does not fit
controls.purpose: Learner's decision on whether the requested completion fits.

controls.label: Submit
controls.purpose: Checks the remaining-token figure and the fits decision together; two attempts per challenge.

controls.label: Next Challenge / Open Exploration Mode
controls.purpose: Enabled after a challenge is answered correctly or missed; advances to the next challenge, and after challenge 3 opens exploration mode.

controls.label: Window
controls.purpose: Exploration mode: window size from 8,000 to 128,000 tokens in steps of 8,000 (default 32,000).

controls.label: System prompt
controls.purpose: Exploration mode: system prompt from 0 to 2,000 tokens in steps of 100 (default 600).

controls.label: History
controls.purpose: Exploration mode: history from 0 to 20,000 tokens in steps of 500 (default 4,000).

controls.label: Attachment
controls.purpose: Exploration mode: attachment from 0 to 40,000 tokens in steps of 500 (default 11,000).

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Worked calculation with committed answers, two attempts and a hint, followed by free exploration of a stacked-bar budget
keyQuestions: How many tokens are left for the answer?
Does the completion share the window with the prompt?
What happens when the prompt alone exceeds the window?
commonMisconceptions: The context window limits only the prompt, so the completion is free
Words and tokens are the same unit
Content that does not fit is rejected with a visible error, when it may instead be dropped silently
assessmentOpportunities: Mastery is 3 of 3 challenges correct: the remaining-token figure exactly equals the answer key and the fits decision matches
Changing the sliders in exploration mode is not evidence of mastery
